notes.subject: יתרם
notes.rationale: יֶתֶר em i 'hap bilong samting i stap ova' o 'rope bilong haus sel'; KJV 'excellency' vs ASV/JPS 'tent-cord' — mi holim 'rope bilong haus sel', wankain olsem piksa bilong pulimapim sel.

notes.subject: נסע
notes.rationale: נָסַע em i 'pulimapim pin bilong sel, go wokabaut' — mi tanim olsem 'pulimapin pinis', piksa bilong sel i pundaun.

notes.subject: Elifas i toktok wantaim Jop
notes.rationale: Askim i go stret long narapela man — 'I no…?' em i askim bilong pasin bikhain.

translation: I no ol i pulimapin pinis rope bilong haus sel bilong ol? Ol i dai, na i no long save.

tokens.gloss: rope bilong haus sel bilong ol
